---
title: Safe embeds
---

Well-known embed providers are allowed via the iframe host allowlist. These
should pass through with their attributes intact (except for `srcdoc`, which
is always stripped as a defense in depth).

Padding content: the post discusses how feed readers handle embedded media.
Modern readers (Feedbin, Inoreader, NewsBlur, NetNewsWire) render iframes
from well-known providers. Blanket-dropping iframes would remove legitimate
embedded video and audio from the author's feed. The host allowlist keeps
these providers while rejecting arbitrary URLs.

## YouTube

<iframe
  src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/dQw4w9WgXcQ"
  width="560"
  height="315"
  title="Demo"
  allowfullscreen
></iframe>

## Vimeo

<iframe
  src="https://player.vimeo.com/video/123456"
  width="640"
  height="360"
  title="Vimeo clip"
></iframe>

## Defense in depth — srcdoc should be stripped

<iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/abc" srcdoc="<script>alert(1)</script>"></iframe>
